local_services: run-owned temporary ComfyUI using the existing aki-v2 target read-only

target_roots.runtime_base: run-owned temporary directory outside repository and target roots

required_preconditions: executed candidate and harness equal the bound SHA values
aki-v2 main.py and python.exe normalize exactly to authorized targets
fresh live-04 evidence destination is absent and atomically reserved before external actions
authorized image SHA-256 matches before copying into the run-owned input root
Windows-native and WSL GPU samples agree within 128 MiB and used memory is <=4096 MiB before service start
no target process and no listener on 8191/11434 before service start
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD is true and owned Ollama has zero non-loopback connections for >=10 seconds and >=5 samples
exact local gemma4:26b exists without download
all required class_type values are present in the live registry before the effective image attempt
required_checks: drive the hash-bound image through public Comfy /prompt and /history using the real input and bridge owners
validate real lvw.prompt/1 domains.observation and text_en semantic Oracle
prove distinct raw_response and suggestion, no automatic draft write, and explicit adopt draft_epoch increment
exercise manual CPU public route after owned Ollama stop
write parseable minimized run-summary and SHA-256 manifest without tensor/current_inputs/traceback/private paths
prove per-call unload, terminal /api/ps empty, owned-only cleanup, empty target ports, removed temp and unchanged target fingerprints
leave fixed product cases NOT_RUN pending independent WP-S1-04 review
mandatory_stops: candidate, harness, target, model, sample, run ID or evidence destination mismatch
identity, GPU, process, port, no-cloud or non-loopback gate failure
GPU memory reaches or exceeds 23552 MiB
public /prompt, /history, registry, semantic Oracle or state-isolation failure
any attempt, model-call, service-start or public-submission budget would be exceeded
listener ownership cannot be re-proven before termination
terminal evidence serialization, minimization or write failure
per-call unload, final cleanup, target integrity or privacy gap
forbidden: downloads, upgrades or permanent target configuration writes
termination of non-owned or no-longer-proven processes
contract, denominator, owner, Oracle, timeout or threshold changes
media other than the single hash-bound image
reuse of live-01/live-02/live-03 evidence or prior authorizations
evidence_minimization: persist aliases, hashes, aggregate counts, authorized listener owner IDs and whitelisted stable diagnostics only; never persist media bytes, tensor/current_inputs, traceback, private paths, unrelated process tables or command lines
cleanup: unload every model call, require terminal /api/ps empty, re-prove listener ownership before termination, stop run-owned PIDs, prove ports empty, remove run-owned paths and prove target fingerprints unchanged
expires_when: one terminal WP-S1-03 live-04 receipt is generated, the single effective image attempt is consumed, or any mandatory stop occurs
